args.prompt: A cute STAR BLOCK for a platformer: a square golden-yellow block with a thick lighter bevel, a big white-yellow five-pointed star embossed in the middle, and tiny cloud-pink corner studs. Draw exactly 8 frames in ONE horizontal row, equally spaced, same size, plenty of empty space between: (1)-(4) idle shine cycle, a diagonal white glint sweeping across the block; (5)-(6) just got hit from below, the block bumped up a little and squashed with sparkles; (7)-(8) EMPTY used block, dull lavender-grey with a faded star shape, no sparkle. Each block is about 18 percent of the image height. 16-bit Super Nintendo style pixel art, chunky hard square pixels, a clean 1-pixel dark plum outline, flat cel shading, light from the top left, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no text, no watermark. Solid flat cyan background, nothing else.
